plan.title: School Enrolment & Infrastructure Overview
plan.subtitle: Analysis of multi-year enrolment trends, gender distribution, and facility availability across schools

panels.title: Total Enrolment (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024") AS total_enrolment FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Girls Share (2024)
panels.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM("Girls 2024") / NULLIF(SUM("Girls 2024" + "Boys 2024"), 0) AS girls_share FROM school_enrolment_by_year

panels.title: Functional Girls Toilets Coverage
panels.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'Yes' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS toilet_pct FROM school_infrastructure

panels.title: Enrolment Trend by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT year, gender, SUM(students) AS enrolment FROM (SELECT '2022' AS year, 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2022") AS students FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2022' AS year, 'Boys' AS gender, SUM("Boys 2022") AS students FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2023' AS year, 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2023") AS students FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2023' AS year, 'Boys' AS gender, SUM("Boys 2023") AS students FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2024' AS year, 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2024") AS students FROM school_enrolment_by_year UNION ALL SELECT '2024' AS year, 'Boys' AS gender, SUM("Boys 2024") AS students FROM school_enrolment_by_year) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: 2024 Enrolment by Block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block" AS block, SUM("Girls 2024") AS girls, SUM("Boys 2024") AS boys FROM school_enrolment_by_year GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (SUM("Girls 2024") + SUM("Boys 2024")) DESC

panels.title: Infrastructure Provisioning Rates
panels.sql: SELECT facility, coverage_pct FROM (SELECT 'Functional Girls Toilet' AS facility, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'Yes' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS coverage_pct FROM school_infrastructure UNION ALL SELECT 'Drinking Water' AS facility, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "Drinking water" = 'Yes' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS coverage_pct FROM school_infrastructure UNION ALL SELECT 'Electricity' AS facility, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN "Electricity" = 'Yes' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS coverage_pct FROM school_infrastructure) ORDER BY coverage_pct DESC

panels.title: School-Level Facilities and 2024 Enrolment
panels.sql: SELECT e."School Name" AS school_name, e."Block" AS block, (e."Girls 2024" + e."Boys 2024") AS total_2024, e."Girls 2024" AS girls_2024, e."Boys 2024" AS boys_2024, i."Toilets functional (girls)" AS girls_toilet, i."Drinking water" AS drinking_water, i."Electricity" AS electricity, i."Classrooms" AS classrooms FROM school_enrolment_by_year e LEFT JOIN school_infrastructure i ON e."School Code" = i."School Code" ORDER BY total_2024 DESC LIMIT 15

plan.narrative:
Across the reporting schools, total enrolment reached {{p1.total_enrolment}} students in 2024, with girls representing {{p2.girls_share}}% of the student body. Tracking across 2022 to 2024 shows the progress in parity across administrative blocks.

Infrastructure assessments reveal critical basic provisioning, with functional girls' toilets accessible in {{p3.toilet_pct}}% of surveyed facilities. Ensuring all schools achieve comprehensive water, sanitation, and power access remains vital alongside student retention.
